PLAN "12-Week General Fitness — Post-MI Recovery"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary general_fitness:
    name "Safe cardiovascular and muscular conditioning post-MI"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Steady Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 20m
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          quad_stretch 1m
          calf_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
